record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four units in appliesTo (Tauros and its three breeds) declare RAGING_BULL in this production reference, all 3 stars, maxPP 100, range 1, passive NONE in the catalog. Each breed is its own registered class; the strategy is shared.
record.summary: Single-target ability: armor reduction on the target for 3000 ms, then the target's reflect, protect and magicBounce flags and cooldowns are cleared directly, then special damage (20/40/80/160 raw by the caster's stars) is dealt. The order matters: protect and magicBounce are removed before the damage call, so they do not block this hit; skydiving is not cleared and still blocks it.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not traced beyond the attacking-state gate.

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit, which requires EffectEnum.ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false
effects.resolution: requested amount = raw x AP factor [x crit]. The armor reduction applied just before makes handleDamage use Math.round(speDef / 2) instead of speDef in the division damage / (1 + 0.05 x speDef) (ceil, min 1), so the applied amount is computed against the halved SPE_DEF; later untraced modifiers follow. takenDamage (not used by this strategy) would count HP removed plus shield damage. Blocked entirely only by skydiving (protect and magicBounce were cleared first).

statusEffects.applicationOrder: first, before the barrier flags are cleared and before the damage
statusEffects.guards: not applied if runeProtect; duration passes through applyStatusDurationReductions (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, HYDRATION x0.5, WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, ODD_KEYSTONE -10% per stone); a new application replaces the remaining time only if longer
statusEffects.combatEffect: while set, handleDamage halves the target's def and speDef (Math.round(x / 2)) for damage reduction; the same halving appears in the POWER_LENS retaliation computation (handleSpecialDamage) and in an items.ts second-hit calculation. Other readers of the flag were not searched beyond app/core and app/models.

statusEffects.applicationOrder: after armor reduction, before the damage call
statusEffects.guards: none: the six assignments run unconditionally; skydiving is not touched
statusEffects.combatEffect: protect: handleDamage and handleSpecialDamage no longer block; magicBounce: the bounce branch in handleSpecialDamage no longer fires; reflect: only affects PHYSICAL damage in handleDamage and this hit is SPECIAL. Protect can be reapplied by triggerProtect later (unless the target is enraged); the removal is not a lasting immunity.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; all four listed units are 3-star in the catalog, so their bare value is 80. The 160 value (also the fallback) is not reachable by their bare star count. The 3000 ms armor reduction does not vary with stars.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (the unit must have a target at range to reach the cast gate).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast clears the barrier flags and refreshes the armor reduction only if the new duration is longer.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 80 for the four 3-star units and armor reduction 3000 ms. Requested damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor]; applied damage uses the halved SPE_DEF (rounded) in the division, ceil and minimum 1, then untraced later modifiers. Armor reduction duration is requested 3000 ms and applied after the duration reductions.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after the later handleDamage modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); only the SPECIAL speDef division, the armor-reduction halving, the minimum of 1 and the takenDamage accounting were read
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution beyond the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier
What other code applies protect / magicBounce / reflect to the target after the removal (only triggerProtect was read)
unresolved: Whether any item or synergy effect changes RAGING_BULL beyond what is listed
Whether skydiving can coexist with the other barrier flags on the same target in practice (not traced)
No other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue
